purpose: Maintained list of job sources that are still useful for the research pipeline.
strategy: Keep only sources that are currently productive, manually defensible, or explicitly retained as manual-only references.

sites.name: RemoteOK API
sites.notes: Best current machine-readable feed. Must use fit-aware filtering; raw keyword matches are too noisy. Count success only when retained roles are logged with keep/reject reasons.

sites.name: Hacker News Jobs
sites.notes: Source is reachable and still useful for startup roles, but requires stronger filtering and logging than simple title scans.

sites.name: Jobberman
sites.notes: Strong Nigeria-first source with visible software/data and remote-tech sections. Good immediate replacement lane after Sifax loss; needs fit-aware filtering to avoid generic non-engineering noise.

sites.name: MyJobMag IT
sites.notes: Useful Nigeria-based IT board with current frontend/backend/mobile roles and salary snippets on some listings. Good for Lagos/Abuja plus remote-within-Nigeria searches.

sites.name: Hot Nigerian Jobs - Computer / AI / Technology
sites.notes: Large Nigeria-focused index with broad volume. Keep as a wider net / fallback source because signal quality is noisier and many listings are not strong frontend/mobile fits.

sites.name: RemoteOK Web
sites.notes: Useful for manual verification against the API feed and for checking roles the API formatting hides.

sites.name: Moniepoint Careers
sites.notes: High-signal Nigeria fintech company page. Better fit quality than general boards even when salary is not always explicit.

sites.name: Kuda Careers
sites.notes: Nigeria-founded fintech careers page. Strong direct-company source for frontend/mobile/product-engineering roles.

sites.name: Flutterwave Careers
sites.notes: Likely useful, but the page is dynamic/noisy in light fetches; prefer browser verification when harvesting listings.

sites.name: Paystack Careers
sites.notes: Strong direct-company target, but current fetch path hit anti-bot protection. Keep as browser/manual follow-up source.

sites.name: Chowdeck Careers
sites.notes: Redirects into BambooHR. Good direct-company startup source for product/engineering roles when openings exist.

sites.name: Bamboo Careers
sites.notes: High-signal Nigeria fintech target, but the guessed public careers path returned 404 in light fetch. Keep for browser/manual discovery of the current jobs page.

sites.name: Risevest Careers
sites.notes: Strong Nigeria startup/fintech target, but the guessed careers URL returned 404. Keep for browser/manual discovery of the current jobs page.

sites.name: Glovo Careers
sites.notes: Useful regional startup target, but the tested Nigeria careers path did not expose listings in light fetch. Keep for browser/manual follow-up.

sites.name: FairMoney Careers
sites.notes: High-signal Nigeria fintech target. Page is reachable; use browser verification when harvesting live openings.

sites.name: PiggyVest Careers
sites.notes: Strong Nigeria fintech/company page with readable public content. Good direct-company source for engineering/product roles.

sites.name: Arbeitnow - English Speaking Jobs in Germany
sites.notes: Strong Germany lane for international candidates. Publicly exposes English-speaking roles plus dedicated visa sponsorship and relocation views; especially useful for Berlin/Munich/Hamburg tech searches.

sites.name: Berlin Startup Jobs - Engineering
sites.notes: High-signal Berlin startup engineering board with many English-first product and software roles. Good route for relocation-minded applications into Germany's startup ecosystem.

sites.name: Pegel - Berlin Visa Sponsorship Jobs
sites.notes: Very strong Germany-move source because it focuses on Berlin startup roles with explicit or strongly signaled visa sponsorship and no-German-required filters. Narrower than the full market, but high-value.

sites.name: EnglishJobs.de
sites.notes: Large English-speaking Germany job board. Broader than Berlin-only sources and useful for finding roles outside the most crowded startup hubs.

sites.name: WeAreDevelopers Jobs - Germany
sites.notes: Large Germany developer board with visible stacks, locations, and salary on some listings. Useful for frontend, backend, mobile, and DevOps filtering across German cities.

sites.name: Jobriver Germany IT Jobs
sites.notes: Germany-focused IT board with strong location and tech-stack coverage. Keep as a wide Germany net for manual/browser follow-up; the current automated path is too slow/noisy for the recurring cron lane.

sites.name: Relocate.me — Netherlands
sites.notes: Top-tier NL source because every listing signals relocation/visa friendliness. Shows companies like Picnic, Catawiki, and other EU tech employers open to international candidates. Use role=frontend or role=software for different sweeps.

sites.name: IamExpat — IT & Tech Jobs in Netherlands
sites.notes: Large expat-focused NL job board with dedicated IT/tech section. English-first roles targeting international candidates. Page is JS-heavy so prefer browser for harvesting; light fetch works for existence checks.

sites.name: Relocate.me — UAE
sites.notes: Same relocation-friendly platform as NL lane, filtered for UAE (Dubai/Abu Dhabi). Good for tech roles in the Gulf with explicit international-candidate openness.

sites.name: LinkedIn Jobs — UAE Remote/Tech
sites.notes: LinkedIn UAE lane — Dubai/Abu Dhabi have the highest volume of Gulf tech roles. Manual/browser only. Bayt, NaukriGulf, and Gulftalent were tested and blocked by bot protection; LinkedIn is the strongest manual UAE source remaining.

sites.name: Dubai Careers (Government Portal)
sites.notes: Official Dubai government careers portal — sometimes includes IT/tech roles in government entities. Keep as a browser manual follow-up; not automated.

sites.name: Make it in Germany Job Listings
sites.notes: Official Germany route for foreign professionals, but light fetch currently hits browser verification. Keep as a trusted manual/browser follow-up source for official cross-checking.

sites.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sites.notes: Retain only as a manual source. Do not treat it as an automated pipeline source.

sites.name: Y Combinator Companies Directory
sites.notes: Use for targeted company follow-up, not as a broad automated board.

retired_sources.reason: not a reliable automated target for this pipeline

minimum_output_rule.failure_rule: Do not call the jobs lane successful just because a source responded.

maintenance.frequency: fortnightly or after a breakage review
check: verify RemoteOK API still returns usable data
verify Hacker News Jobs still loads
verify Jobberman/MyJobMag/HotNigerianJobs pages still expose usable listings
verify Germany sources (Arbeitnow, BerlinStartupJobs, Pegel, EnglishJobs, WeAreDevelopers) still expose usable listings
verify Netherlands sources (Relocate.me NL, IamExpat IT/Tech) still expose usable listings
verify UAE sources (Relocate.me UAE, LinkedIn UAE) still produce useful leads
spot-check Jobriver manually and only re-automate it if the scrape path becomes reliably fast again
re-check whether Make it in Germany still requires browser/manual verification or has become scrapeable again
verify Nigeria fintech/company career pages still expose usable listings
prune stale/manual-only sources when they stop adding value
keep the recommendations aligned with actual working sources
